# Matla Al Anwar — Painting & Sofa Cleaning (UAE)

> Matla Al Anwar (matlaalanwar.ae) provides professional house painting and sofa cleaning services across all seven emirates of the UAE: interior and exterior painting, apartment and villa repainting, move-in/move-out painting, and deep sofa, upholstery, majlis, carpet and mattress cleaning.

## Contact
- Website: https://matlaalanwar.ae
- Phone: +971 50 000 0000
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/971500000000
- Email: info@matlaalanwar.ae
- Areas: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah, Umm Al Quwain

## Starting prices (AED)
- Studio apartment painting: from 650
- 1 bedroom apartment painting: from 950
- 2 bedroom apartment painting: from 1,400
- Villa painting: from 3,500
- 3-seater sofa deep clean: from 149
- L-shape / 5–7 seater sofa: from 249
- Mattress cleaning: from 99
